name: MFA step-up & contact verification — mobile (375px) — approval frames
description: Mobile (375px, Android TWA viewport) treatment of the provider-neutral Security API step-up and contact-verification UX requested in issue #251: choose-a-factor, OTP code entry, phone contact verification, and a combined mobile security-status screen. Built for Issue #251's design-review request. Reconciled against already-in-repo flows (see `reconciliation` below) rather than shipping a disconnected fourth pattern for the same data: extends the unapproved `mfa-management` step-up flow with an explicit mobile/375px treatment and the missing loading/empty/generic-error states; adds a genuinely new phone-OTP verification screen while leaving the already-approved email link-click pattern (`auth-experience` `verify-email`) untouched; and adds an additive mobile security-status screen rather than a duplicate of the approved `account-security` hub. No vendor name appears anywhere in the UI. Approving a flow approves its component/package plan before UI implementation; frontend-test-engineer drives Playwright against the data-frame/data-* hooks.

notes: mfa-management/05-step-up-challenge.html (flow mfa-step-up, approved: false) already covers choose-a-factor + TOTP entry at a desktop 420px card width with no 375px validation and no loading/empty/generic-error states. This feature's 01-choose-factor.html and 02-enter-code.html are the missing mobile treatment of THAT SAME flow (same route /login/mfa, same OtpInput/FactorPicker primitives) plus the states CLAUDE.md's design-first gate requires — not a second, divergent step-up design. Implementation should land as mfa-management's mfa-step-up flow gaining a responsive (375px) layout, not as a parallel component tree.

auth-experience/04-verify-landing.html (flow verify-email, approved: true, shipped pattern) is a link-click state machine for post-signup EMAIL verification. Issue #251 proposed replacing it with 6-cell-OTP code entry for email too. That is a real, user-facing behavior change (link vs. code) on an already-approved flow, and this feature deliberately does NOT make that change without an explicit owner ruling. 03-confirm-contact.html in this feature therefore scopes the OTP code-entry pattern to PHONE verification only (which has no existing frame at all) and links to the existing approved email flow instead of re-implementing it. If the owner wants email moved to code-entry too, that is a follow-up PR against auth-experience's own manifest, called out explicitly as a behavior change, not bundled here.

account-security/01-hub.html + 02-states.html (flow account-security, approved: true) already own the account's security-posture overview and the hasPassword:null fail-closed guard. 04-security-status.html here is an ADDITIVE, mobile-shaped combined view (2FA factor status + contact verification chips in one TWA screen) — it reuses the hub's badge/chip language and does not duplicate or re-derive password state. It is not a fourth security-status surface competing with the hub; it is the mobile shape the hub does not yet have (the hub's own mobile breakpoint collapses its card grid to one column but keeps the desktop sidebar shell, which doesn't fit a chromeless TWA screen).
openQuestionsForOwner: Should auth-experience's approved verify-email flow also move from link-click to OTP code-entry for consistency with phone, or stay link-click? This feature assumes 'stay link-click' (least change to an approved flow) pending an explicit ruling.

Should the mobile security-status screen (04) become the TWA app's canonical account-security entry point, or stay a secondary/deep-linked view alongside the desktop hub? This feature assumes 'secondary, additive' pending an explicit ruling.

missingDesignSystemPrimitives.name: OtpInput
missingDesignSystemPrimitives.reason: Already named as missing by mfa-management's manifest (6-cell, paste-aware, arrow-key nav). This feature reuses the SAME primitive at a mobile touch-target size (42x52, min 44px tap target) rather than defining a second one-off OTP field.

frames.label: Index
frames.summary: Flow walker + build inventory + reconciliation notes against mfa-management, auth-experience and account-security.
frames.acceptanceNotes: index links to every frame in order; the reconciliation notes are visible, not just in manifest.json.

frames.label: (01) Choose a factor
frames.summary: Mobile factor picker (authenticator / email / SMS / recovery) at 375px, plus loading skeleton, generic load-error, and a zero-factors fail-closed state not present in the desktop frame.
frames.acceptanceNotes: Factor list driven by mfa_required.factors; SMS/email offered only when enrolled. Loading shows skeleton rows, not a blank screen. Load error offers retry only (no silent fallback). Zero-factors is fail-closed to a support contact, never a dead end.

frames.label: (02) Enter code
frames.summary: Mobile OTP entry (auto-advance, paste-aware, 44px+ touch cells) with in-flight/verifying, wrong/expired fail-closed (no navigation), expiry countdown + resend cooldown, and delivery-failure fallback.
frames.acceptanceNotes: Verify via POST /mfa/verify; a wrong/expired code stays on screen with an inline error, never navigates away. The verify button disables and shows a spinner while in flight so a slow network can't produce a double-submit. Resend is disabled during the cooldown window with a live countdown.

frames.label: (03) Confirm your phone
frames.summary: Phone-only OTP verification: enter phone -> sending -> enter code -> verified, with wrong-code and generic send-failure fail-closed states, and 'Skip for now' (re-prompts from profile). Email verification intentionally stays on the existing approved link-click pattern (linked in copy, not re-implemented here) — see manifest reconciliation notes.
frames.acceptanceNotes: POST /verify/phone/start then /verify/phone/confirm. Wrong/expired code shows inline error, no navigation. A generic send failure (not a bad code) offers retry or skip, never a silent hang. Skip is always available and the manifest records that profile re-prompts until verified.

frames.label: (04) Security status (profile)
frames.summary: Combined mobile 2FA + contact-verification status (Active/Verified/Unverified chips), with loading skeleton, generic load-error, and the remove-last-2FA-factor -> 409 fail-closed guard (reusing mfa-management's RemoveFactorDialog pattern) when the account's only active factor is removed under an enforced-MFA policy.
frames.acceptanceNotes: Status rows render only confirmed server state (no optimistic 'Active'/'Verified' before the server says so). DELETE /mfa/factors/{factorId} on the only active factor returns 409 and the UI blocks removal via the bottom-sheet dialog, routing to 'Add another method first' rather than silently succeeding. Password state is out of scope here (owned by account-security/02-states.html) and is not duplicated.
